Subject: CloudHaven renewal origination + QBR poll and capacity notes

Hi Samantha & Derek —

Thanks again for the partnership this year. As we approach your renewal window (Feb 2027), I wanted to get an origination thread started so we can align on term options, capacity needs, and a QBR cadence. High-level ask: can we lock in a 30–45 minute origination/QBR in the next two weeks to cover usage trends, an upsell path to Dedicated pools, and any procurement requirements?

Quick context for the meeting:
- CloudHaven (prod): current hosted plan, average concurrent qps spikes at month-end (~40% higher).
- Customer ask: evaluate Dedicated for predictable throughput and discuss a 24-month term with staircase seat increases in Q2/Q3.
- Internal goal: propose a scaled Dedicated pilot + conservative staircase pricing that preserves unit economics.

Proposed slots (all PST):
- Wed 12/09 9:30–10:00am
- Thu 12/10 2:00–2:30pm
- Mon 12/14 11:00–11:45am

Next steps I suggest:
1) Confirm attendees and preferred slot.
2) I’ll share a short usage snapshot and Dedicated pricing draft ahead of the call.
3) If Procurement will be involved early, please loop them so we can align on contracts and any PO cadence.

Attaching a CSV export of last 90 days of token and peak concurrency to help the capacity conversation (CloudHaven_Q1_usage.csv).

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Best,
Soojin Lee

Soojin —

Thanks for the primer and the usage export; that helps. We’re definitely interested in a Dedicated pilot for predictable month-end spikes. A couple of asks from our side before the call:

- Can you include a simple mutual action plan (MAP) draft so we can see milestones and acceptance criteria for the pilot?
- We’ll need an expected SLA uplift and an estimated cost delta per 1k peak tokens.
- Procurement is cc’d. Please note: we prefer a 30–60 day review window for contract changes.

Availability: Thu 12/10 2:00pm works for Samantha and Procurement. Derek can do Mon 12/14 if needed, but he’ll be remote.

Thanks — looking forward to the discussion.

Best,

Looping in engineering context and a suggested timeline — thanks for starting this thread, Soojin.

Samantha — quick notes before Thu’s call:
- Pilot proposal: 4-week Dedicated pilot sized to 1.25x observed peak. That gives headroom while we validate batching and prefix cache effects.
- SLA uplift: target 99.9 p99 latency for generation paths; we can include 30-min incident response in the pilot SLO.
- Pricing: attached a pricing draft with an annualized 24-month term view and staircase increments at month 6 and month 12 (redwood_dedicated_pricing_v2.pdf). We modeled a conservative 12% unit-cost reduction with steady state batching at expected volumes.

Proposed origination run-of-show (20–30 min):
1) Usage & pain points (CloudHaven) — 5–7 min
2) Pilot scope & success metrics (Redwood) — 8–10 min
3) Procurement & timeline checkpoints — 5 min
4) Next steps & owners — 2–3 min

Action items for the meeting:
- Soojin: share MAP draft + updated pricing slides (before Thu 2pm PST).
- Ben: prepare rollout risks and fallback plan (will be on the call).
- Samantha/Procurement: confirm internal reviewers and timing.

Attachment: redwood_dedicated_pricing_v2.pdf (pdf)

-Karthik
